sentences.japanese: 彼女は費用を顧みず家を飾りたてた。
sentences.english: She decorated her house regardless of cost.

sentences.japanese: 顧みられぬ無数の漂流者が家を求めてる。
sentences.english: A hundred billion castaways are looking for a home.

sentences.japanese: お年寄りは過去を顧みてしまいがちだ。
sentences.english: Old people are inclined to look back on the past.

sentences.japanese: 今日もまた半生を顧みました。
sentences.english: Today I reminisced on my youth yet again.
